#### F3. 전체 교체 `Frontend/nh-atms-web/src/config/constants.ts`

> 이 파일: 화면 폭 기준(밴드 1024·1280, 최소 폭 840, 패널 접힘 1093) × 0.8.

```ts
/** 화면 폭 밴드 경계(px). 08_프론트_반응형_제안 §2 — 2026-11-13 화면 비율 0.8 에 맞춰 예전(1280·1600) × 0.8 */
export const BAND_BREAKPOINTS = { M: 1024, L: 1280 } as const;
/** 콘텐츠 최소 폭(px). 이하에서는 접지 않고 페이지 가로 스크롤 */
export const CONTENT_MIN_WIDTH = 840;
/** 이 창 폭 미만이면 사이드 패널 기본 접힘(레일 51 + 패널 176 + 콘텐츠 840 + 여백 — 예전 1366 × 0.8) */
export const PANEL_AUTO_COLLAPSE_BELOW = 1093;

/** 열린 화면 탭 최대 개수 */
export const MAX_OPEN_TABS = 12;

/** 홈 화면키 (고정 탭) */
export { HOME_SCREEN_KEY } from '@/screens/screenIds';

/** 그리드 기본 페이지 크기 */
export const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 20;
export const PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS = ['20', '50', '100'];

/** 그리드 빈 결과 문구 (AS-IS 원문 유지) */
export const EMPTY_RESULT_TEXT = '검색된 데이터가 없습니다.';

/** 로컬/세션 스토리지 키 접두어 */
export const STORAGE_PREFIX = 'nh-atms';
```

#### F4. 전체 교체 `Frontend/nh-atms-web/src/theme/global.css`

> 이 파일: CSS 변수(글자 11.2·10.4·9.6px 등)와 모든 px × 0.8 + 표 바깥 테두리·'총 n건' 줄 + 필수 검색필터 라벨 = 빨간 점 하나(antd '*' 겹침 제거).

```css
/* ===== Pretendard (폐쇄망 로컬 서빙) ===== */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'Pretendard';
  src: url('/fonts/PretendardVariable.woff2') format('woff2-variations');
  font-weight: 45 920;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* ===== 디자인 토큰 (theme/tokens.ts 와 동일 값) — 2026-11-13 가독성 개선: 흐린 글자도 대비 4.5:1 이상. 화면 비율(같은 날 결정): 크롬 80% 비율을 100% 기본으로 — px 는 모두 예전 × 0.8(글자 11.2·10.4·9.6px) ===== */
:root {
  --nh-blue: #0054a6;
  --nh-blue-hover: #005eb8;
  --nh-blue-active: #003b75;
  --nh-gold: #ffb81c;
  --primary: #054681;
  --primary-hover: #0b5aa3;
  --accent: #1d5fcf;
  --success: #1f9d55;
  --success-bg: #e8f7ee;
  --danger: #e0392c;
  --danger-bg: #fdecec;
  --warning: #f59e0b;
  --warning-bg: #fff4e0;
  --info: #2f80ed;
  --info-bg: #eaf2ff;
  --neutral: #8c8c8c;
  --neutral-bg: #f0f0f0;
  --bg-page: #f4f8fd;
  --bg-panel: #ffffff;
  --bg-subtle: #f7fafd;
  --bg-search: #f3f8fe;
  --bg-table-head: #eef2f7;
  --bg-label-cell: #eef4fb;
  --border: #d3d9e1;
  --border-light: #e2e7ee;
  --text: #1a2433;
  --text-secondary: #454f5e;
  --text-muted: #667180;
  --fs: 11.2px;
  --fs-sm: 10.4px;
  --fs-xs: 9.6px;
  --header-h: 44.8px;
  --tabbar-h: 30.4px;
  --rail-w: 51.2px;
  --panel-w: 176px;
  --content-min: 840px;
  --shadow-card: 0 1px 1.6px rgba(16, 36, 64, 0.04), 0 3.2px 11.2px rgba(16, 36, 64, 0.05);
  --radius-sm: 3.2px;
  --radius: 4.8px;
  --radius-lg: 8px;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body, #root { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
body {
  font-family: 'Pretendard', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Malgun Gothic', sans-serif;
  font-size: var(--fs);
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--text);
  background: var(--bg-page);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
::selection { background: #cfe3ff; }

/* ===== 공통 유틸 클래스 ===== */
.num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }
.mono { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: var(--fs-sm); }
.muted { color: var(--text-muted); }
.ellipsis { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.nowrap { white-space: nowrap; }
.flex { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6.4px; }
.flex-between { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6.4px; }
.gap-4 { gap: 3.2px; } .gap-12 { gap: 9.6px; } .gap-16 { gap: 12.8px; }
.mt-8 { margin-top: 6.4px; } .mt-12 { margin-top: 9.6px; } .mt-16 { margin-top: 12.8px; } .mb-8 { margin-bottom: 6.4px; } .mb-12 { margin-bottom: 9.6px; }

/* ===== 카드/패널 (2026-11-13 콘텐츠가 흰 바탕이라 그림자 없이 테두리만) ===== */
.panel {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}
.panel-body { padding: 11.2px 12.8px; }
.section-title {
  font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6.4px;
}
.section-title .sub { font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 400; color: var(--text-muted); }

/* ===== 조회조건 패널 (2026-11-13 현업 화면 기준: 흰 패널, 라벨은 배경 없이 '• 라벨' + 입력칸, 조회 버튼 우측 남색) ===== */
.search-panel {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 11.2px 16px;
  margin-bottom: 12.8px;
}
.search-panel .ant-form-item { margin-bottom: 0; }
.search-panel .ant-form-item-label { padding-right: 8px; }
.search-panel .ant-form-item-label > label {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-width: 70.4px; height: 25.6px; padding: 0 1.6px 0 3.2px;
  background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-size: var(--fs); font-weight: 600;
}
.search-panel .ant-form-item-label > label::before { content: ''; width: 3.2px; height: 3.2px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--text); margin-right: 6.4px; flex: none; }
/* 필수 = 앞 점만 빨간색. antd 기본 필수 표시('*' 글자, 선택자가 더 구체적)를 같은 구체성으로 덮어 점과 겹쳐 깨지지 않게 */
.search-panel .ant-form-item .ant-form-item-label > label.ant-form-item-required:not(.ant-form-item-required-mark-optional)::before {
  content: ''; display: block; width: 3.2px; height: 3.2px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--danger); margin: 0 6.4px 0 0;
  font-size: 0; line-height: 0; color: transparent; flex: none;
}
.search-panel .ant-form-item-label > label.ant-form-item-required::after { display: none; }
.search-panel .ant-radio-wrapper { margin-right: 8px; }
.search-actions { flex: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4.8px; }
.search-actions > .ant-btn { min-width: 128px; }
.search-actions-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.search-btn.ant-btn { min-width: 128px; height: 27.2px; font-weight: 600; }
.search-toggle { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3.2px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); white-space: nowrap; }
.search-toggle:hover { color: var(--primary); }
.search-toggle .anticon { font-size: 8.8px; }

/* ===== 결과 헤더 ===== */
.result-header {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 9.6px;
  margin-bottom: 6.4px; min-height: 24px;
}
.result-header .count { font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; }
.result-header .count b { color: var(--text); }
.result-header .count .n { color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 500; font-size: var(--fs); margin-left: 3.2px; }
.result-header .count .sel { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--fs-sm); margin-left: 6.4px; }

/* ===== 에코바(조회 조건 반영 요약) — AS-IS 레이아웃 킷 ===== */
.echo-bar {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(128px, 1fr));
  border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 8px; background: #fff;
}
.echo-bar .cell { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-right: 1px solid var(--border-light); min-height: 24px; }
.echo-bar .cell .k { background: var(--bg-label-cell); padding: 4.8px 8px; min-width: 70.4px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-secondary); white-space: nowrap; }
.echo-bar .cell .v { padding: 4.8px 8px; flex: 1; text-align: right; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.echo-bar .cell .v.left { text-align: left; }
.echo-bar .cell .v.danger { color: var(--danger); font-weight: 700; }
.echo-bar .cell .v.warn { color: var(--warning); font-weight: 700; }

/* ===== 데이터 그리드 ===== */
.data-grid .ant-table { font-size: var(--fs); }
.data-grid .ant-table-thead > tr > th {
  text-align: center !important; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text) !important; white-space: nowrap;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important;
}
.data-grid .ant-table-tbody > tr > td { white-space: nowrap; }
.data-grid .ant-table-cell-fix-left, .data-grid .ant-table-cell-fix-right { background: inherit; }
.data-grid .ant-table-tbody > tr.row-clickable { cursor: pointer; }
.data-grid .ant-table-summary > tr > td { background: var(--bg-subtle); font-weight: 600; }
/* 페이지 줄(시안): 왼쪽 안내 / 가운데 페이지 / 오른쪽 'N개씩 보기' */
.data-grid .grid-foot { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 6.4px; margin-top: 8px; min-height: 22.4px; }
.data-grid .grid-foot .gf-left { font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.data-grid .grid-foot .ant-pagination { justify-content: center; margin: 0; }
.data-grid .grid-foot .gf-size { justify-self: end; width: 94.4px; }
/* 표 끝 구분(2026-11-13 사용자 결정): 테두리 없는 표도 바깥 테두리 상자로 감싸 마지막 행 아래 끝선이 보이게 + 페이징 없는 표는 아래 '총 n건' 한 줄(DataGrid·EditableGrid) */
.data-grid .ant-table:not(.ant-table-bordered) .ant-table-container { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
.data-grid .ant-table:not(.ant-table-bordered) .ant-table-container .ant-table-thead > tr > th:first-child { border-start-start-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
.data-grid .ant-table:not(.ant-table-bordered) .ant-table-container .ant-table-thead > tr > th:last-child { border-start-end-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
.data-grid .ant-table-bordered .ant-table-container { border-color: var(--border) !important; }
.data-grid .grid-foot.grid-foot-plain { display: flex; margin-top: 6.4px; min-height: 0; }
.data-grid .ant-table-thead > tr > th { background: var(--bg-table-head); padding-top: 5.6px; padding-bottom: 5.6px; }
/* 머리글 칸 사이 세로줄을 또렷하게(현업 화면 기준) */
.data-grid .ant-table-thead > tr > th:not(:last-child)::before { background-color: var(--border) !important; height: 100% !important; }
.data-grid .ant-table-tbody > tr > td { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
/* 행 안 작은 버튼은 행 높이를 키우지 않게(시안 행 약 28px) */
.data-grid .ant-table-tbody .ant-btn-sm { height: 19.2px; line-height: 17.6px; padding: 0 6.4px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); }
/* 정렬 아이콘은 머리글에 마우스를 올리거나 정렬 중일 때만(시안 머리글은 글자만) */
.data-grid .ant-table-thead th .ant-table-column-sorter { opacity: 0; transition: opacity .12s; }
.data-grid .ant-table-thead th:hover .ant-table-column-sorter, .data-grid .ant-table-thead th.ant-table-column-sort .ant-table-column-sorter { opacity: 1; }
.data-grid .grid-empty { padding: 22.4px 0; color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; }
.data-grid .cell-stack { line-height: 1.25; }
.data-grid .cell-stack small { display: block; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: var(--fs-xs); }
.data-grid td.cell-hl { background: #fff8e1; }
.data-grid td.cell-danger { color: var(--danger); font-weight: 600; }
.data-grid td.cell-success { color: var(--success); font-weight: 600; }

/* ===== 상세 폼 그리드(라벨/값 표 — 상세·등록 팝업 형태) ===== */
.detail-grid { display: grid; border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden; background: #fff; }
.detail-grid .dg-k { background: var(--bg-label-cell); padding: 5.6px 9.6px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-right: 1px solid var(--border-light); display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28.8px; }
.detail-grid .dg-k.req::after { content: '*'; color: var(--danger); margin-left: 2.4px; }
.detail-grid .dg-v { padding: 4px 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-right: 1px solid var(--border-light); display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 28.8px; min-width: 0; }
.detail-grid .dg-v .ant-form-item { width: 100%; }
/* formItem()/formGroup() 칸: 여백 0, 오류 글씨는 컨트롤 아래 작게 (02-dev-guide §4.3) */
.ant-form-item.form-cell { margin: 0; }
.form-cell .ant-form-item-explain { font-size: var(--fs-xs); line-height: 1.4; padding-top: 1.6px; white-space: normal; }
.form-cell .ant-form-item-control-input { min-height: 0; }
.detail-grid .dg-v .ant-input, .detail-grid .dg-v .ant-select, .detail-grid .dg-v .ant-picker { width: 100%; }
.detail-grid .dg-v.num { justify-content: flex-end; }
.detail-grid .dg-v.pre { white-space: pre-wrap; align-items: flex-start; }

/* ===== KPI 카드 ===== */
.kpi-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); padding: 11.2px 12.8px; min-height: 68.8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; }
.kpi-card .kpi-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-weight: 600; }
.kpi-card .kpi-head .lbl { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4.8px; }
.kpi-card .kpi-value { text-align: right; font-size: 20.8px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: -0.5px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; }
.kpi-card .kpi-value small { font-size: var(--fs); font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary); margin-left: 3.2px; }
.kpi-card.kpi-hero .kpi-value { font-size: 28.8px; text-align: left; }
.kpi-card .kpi-sub { font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.delta { font-size: 9.6px; font-weight: 600; padding: 1px 6.4px; border-radius: 8px; }
.delta.up { color: var(--success); background: var(--success-bg); }
.delta.down { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-bg); }
.delta.flat { color: var(--text-secondary); background: var(--neutral-bg); }

/* ===== 상태 태그 ===== */
.status-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3.2px; padding: 1px 7.2px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 600; line-height: 16px; white-space: nowrap; }
.status-tag.success { color: var(--success); background: var(--success-bg); }
.status-tag.danger { color: var(--danger); background: var(--danger-bg); }
.status-tag.warning { color: #b26a00; background: var(--warning-bg); }
.status-tag.info { color: var(--info); background: var(--info-bg); }
.status-tag.neutral { color: var(--text-secondary); background: var(--neutral-bg); }
.status-tag.text { padding: 0; background: transparent; }

/* ===== 격자 카드 — 시안 2026-10-21 p.7: 1600 이상 5열, 선택 = 파랑 테두리, 통신단절 = 빨간 테두리 ===== */
.atm-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(184px, 1fr)); gap: 9.6px; }
[data-band='L'] .atm-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
.atm-card { position: relative; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 8px 9.6px 9.6px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s; }
.atm-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4.8px 14.4px rgba(16,36,64,.12); }
.atm-card.selected { border-color: var(--primary); background: #eef5ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--primary); }
.atm-card.st-danger { background: #fdecec; border-color: var(--danger); }
.atm-card.st-neutral { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%, #f1f5fa 100%); }
.atm-card.st-warning { background: linear-gradient(180deg,#fff 0%, #fff4e0 100%); }
.atm-card .ac-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4.8px; }
.atm-card .ac-head .desc { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.atm-card .ac-body { display: flex; gap: 9.6px; align-items: center; margin: 8px 0 6.4px; }
.atm-card .ac-thumb { width: 38.4px; height: 51.2px; border-radius: 4.8px; background: linear-gradient(180deg,#e9eef5,#cfd8e3); position: relative; flex: none; }
.atm-card .ac-thumb::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; top: 8px; height: 14.4px; background: #5b6b80; border-radius: 1.6px; }
.atm-card .ac-thumb::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 11.2px; right: 11.2px; bottom: 9.6px; height: 4.8px; background: #8f9db0; border-radius: 1.6px; }
.atm-card .ac-id { font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; }
.atm-card .ac-id.danger { color: var(--danger); }
.atm-card .ac-model { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.atm-card .ac-kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38.4px 1fr; row-gap: 3.2px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); }
.atm-card .ac-kv .k { color: var(--text-muted); }
.atm-card .ac-kv .v { text-align: right; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: rgba(255,255,255,.65); border-radius: 2.4px; padding: 0 4.8px; }

/* ===== 공지 목록 ===== */
.notice-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
.notice-list li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 9.6px; padding: 6.4px 1.6px; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border-light); cursor: pointer; }
.notice-list li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.notice-list li:hover .t { color: var(--primary); }
.notice-list .t::before { content: '•'; color: var(--text-muted); margin-right: 6.4px; }
.notice-list .d { color: var(--text-muted); white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* ===== 모달(시안 2026-10-21 p.9): 하단 버튼 가운데, 안내 모달은 문장도 가운데 ===== */
.ant-modal .detail-grid .dg-k { background: var(--bg-label-cell); }
.ant-modal .ant-modal-footer { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 6.4px; }
.ant-modal .ant-modal-footer > .ant-btn + .ant-btn { margin-inline-start: 0; }
.ant-modal-confirm .ant-modal-confirm-body { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; }
.ant-modal-confirm .ant-modal-confirm-paragraph { align-items: center; max-width: 100%; }
.ant-modal-confirm .ant-modal-confirm-btns { display: flex; justify-content: center; margin-top: 14.4px; }
.ant-modal-confirm .ant-modal-confirm-btns > .ant-btn + .ant-btn { margin-inline-start: 6.4px; }
.ant-modal .modal-section { font-weight: 700; font-size: 12px; margin: 9.6px 0 4.8px; }
.ant-modal .modal-section:first-child { margin-top: 0; }

/* ===== 헤더 검색 드롭다운(시안 p.11) ===== */
.gs-popup { padding: 3.2px 0; }
.gs-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 4.8px 9.6px 3.2px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); }
.gs-link { all: unset; cursor: pointer; font-size: var(--fs-xs); font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.gs-link:hover { color: var(--primary); }
.gs-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 3.2px; padding: 1.6px 9.6px 6.4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
.gs-chips .ant-tag { cursor: pointer; margin: 0; border-radius: 9.6px; padding: 1px 6.4px; }
.gs-count { color: var(--text-secondary); }
.gs-empty { padding: 8px 9.6px 9.6px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: var(--fs-sm); }
.gs-item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; padding: 1.6px 0; }
.gs-item .gs-icon { color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 12px; margin-top: 1.6px; }
.gs-item .gs-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; }
.gs-item .gs-name { font-size: var(--fs); font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4.8px; }
.gs-item .gs-name small { font-size: var(--fs-xs); font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted); }
.gs-item .gs-name .hl { color: var(--primary); }
.gs-item .gs-path { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-secondary); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

/* ===== 즐겨찾기 드롭다운(시안 p.10) ===== */
.fav-pop { width: 200px; }
.fav-pop-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 1.6px 6.4px 4.8px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 500; }
.fav-pop .panel-leaf .rm { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-muted); padding: 2.4px; border-radius: 3.2px; }
.fav-pop .panel-leaf .rm:hover { color: var(--danger); background: rgba(0,0,0,.06); }
.fav-pop-foot { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 6.4px 0 1.6px; }

/* ===== 스크롤바 ===== */
*::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #c9d3df; border-radius: 8px; border: 1.6px solid transparent; background-clip: padding-box; }
*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #a9b7c7; background-clip: padding-box; border: 1.6px solid transparent; }
*::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }

/* ===== 인쇄 ===== */
@media print {
  .app-rail, .app-panel, .app-header, .app-tabbar, .search-panel .ant-btn, .no-print { display: none !important; }
  .app-content { overflow: visible !important; padding: 0 !important; }
  .data-grid .ant-table-body { overflow: visible !important; max-height: none !important; }
  @page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 10mm; }
}

/* 데모 빌드 문자 마크 (은행 로고 대신) */
.brand-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 7.2px; border-radius: 4.8px; background: var(--primary); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .4.8px; line-height: 1; box-shadow: inset 0 -2.4px 0 var(--nh-gold); }

/* ---------- 2026-10-23 공통 부품 추가분 ---------- */
/* 안내문 속 화면번호 링크(ScreenLink) */
.screen-link { color: var(--primary, #054681); text-decoration: underline dotted; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; }
.screen-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
/* 강조 텍스트(장애·불능 등) — 인라인 style 대신 사용 */
.text-danger-strong { color: var(--danger); font-weight: 600; }
/* DataGrid 밖(마스터·디테일 등)에서도 같은 빈 안내문 모양 */
.grid-empty { padding: 22.4px 0; color: var(--text-muted); text-align: center; }
/* 저널 원문·명세표 등 고정폭 본문 */
.mono-block { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace); white-space: pre-wrap; font-size: var(--fs-sm); line-height: 1.5; background: var(--bg-subtle); border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 8px 9.6px; margin: 0; }

/* 휴일 표시(TB_NMS_HDAY) — 날짜 선택 달력 칸. hooks/useHolidays holidayCellRender 가 입힌다 */
.holiday-cell .ant-picker-cell-inner { color: var(--danger); font-weight: 600; }

/* 글자 수(바이트) 표시가 있는 TextArea — 숫자가 칸 아래에 붙으므로 자리를 비워 둔다(DetailGrid 칸 overflow 에 잘리지 않게) */
.detail-grid .dg-v .ant-input-textarea-show-count { margin-bottom: 14.4px; }
/* antd 6 Select 의 입력칸(AutoComplete 값·showSearch 검색어)이 브라우저 기본 글자 크기(13.3px)로 커지지 않게 — 다른 칸과 같은 크기 */
.ant-select .ant-select-input { font-size: inherit; }
```

#### F5. 전체 교체 `Frontend/nh-atms-web/src/components/layout/layout.css`

> 이 파일: 머리줄·탭줄·아이콘 줄·사이드 패널 px × 0.8.

```css
/* ===== 앱 셸: 헤더(전폭) / 아이콘 레일 + 사이드 패널 / 오픈탭바 + 콘텐츠 ===== */
.app-shell { display: grid; grid-template-rows: var(--header-h) 1fr; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-page); }
.app-header { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
.app-side { display: flex; height: calc(100vh - var(--header-h)); position: relative; z-index: 20; }
.app-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; height: calc(100vh - var(--header-h)); }
/* 콘텐츠 영역(2026-11-13 사용자 결정): 흰 바탕, 화면은 높이를 꽉 채우고 표가 남은 높이를 차지 → 보통은 스크롤 없음.
   내용이 아주 길 때(표가 최소 높이보다 작아질 때)만 이 영역이 스크롤된다 */
.app-content { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 12.8px 16px 12.8px; background: #fff; }
.app-content-inner { min-width: var(--content-min); height: 100%; }

/* ===== 헤더 (시안 B: 흰 배경, 로고 + 시스템명 + 1뎁스 네비 + 검색) ===== */
.app-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 0 14.4px 0 12.8px; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); height: var(--header-h); }
.app-header .brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; cursor: pointer; flex: none; }
.app-header .brand img { height: 20.8px; }
.app-header .brand .sys-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); letter-spacing: -0.2px; white-space: nowrap; }
.app-header .env-badge { font-size: 8.8px; font-weight: 700; padding: 1px 4.8px; border-radius: 3.2px; background: var(--warning-bg); color: #b26a00; letter-spacing: .2.4px; }
.app-header .env-badge.prod { display: none; }
.top-nav { display: flex; align-items: stretch; height: 100%; margin-left: 8px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; scrollbar-width: none; }
.top-nav::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
/* 1뎁스 메뉴(2026-11-13 현업 화면 기준): 아이콘 + 글자 15px, 항목 사이 얇은 구분선, 선택 = 남색 굵은 글자 + 밑줄(배경 없음) */
.top-nav button { all: unset; cursor: pointer; padding: 0 12.8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4.8px; white-space: nowrap; position: relative; transition: color .15s, background .15s; }
.top-nav button .anticon { font-size: 12.8px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.top-nav button + button::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 1px; height: 12.8px; background: var(--border); }
.top-nav button:hover { color: var(--primary); }
.top-nav button:hover .anticon { color: var(--primary); }
.top-nav button.on { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; }
.top-nav button.on .anticon { color: var(--primary); }
.top-nav button.on::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: 0; height: 2.4px; border-radius: 1.6px 1.6px 0 0; background: var(--primary); }
.header-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex: none; margin-left: auto; }
.header-user { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4.8px; font-size: var(--fs); white-space: nowrap; }
.header-user .muted { font-size: var(--fs-sm); }
/* 헤더 오른쪽 '☆ 즐겨찾기 ▾' 상자(현업 화면 기준 — 검색칸 옆) */
.header-fav { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4.8px; height: 27.2px; min-width: 120px; padding: 0 9.6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6.4px; font-size: var(--fs); font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); background: #fff; white-space: nowrap; }
.header-fav:hover { border-color: var(--primary); }
.header-fav .anticon-down { margin-left: auto; font-size: 8.8px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.global-search .ant-select-selector { border-radius: 6.4px !important; }
.global-search .ant-select-auto-complete, .global-search .ant-input-affix-wrapper { min-height: 27.2px; }
.header-icon-btn { all: unset; cursor: pointer; position: relative; width: 27.2px; height: 27.2px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 13.6px; color: var(--text-secondary); transition: background .12s, color .12s; }
.header-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--bg-subtle); color: var(--primary); }
.header-badge { position: absolute; top: 1px; right: -1px; min-width: 12.8px; height: 12.8px; padding: 0 3.2px; border-radius: 6.4px; background: var(--danger); color: #fff; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.session-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4.8px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); padding: 2.4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-light); border-radius: 11.2px; background: var(--bg-subtle); white-space: nowrap; }
.session-chip b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--text); }
.session-chip.warn b { color: var(--danger); }
.session-chip .ant-btn { height: 16px; padding: 0 4.8px; font-size: 8.8px; }

/* ===== 아이콘 줄 (시안 A: NH 블루) — 사이드바를 접었을 때만 표시 ===== */
.app-rail { width: var(--rail-w); background: var(--nh-blue); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; flex: none; }
.rail-expand { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 27.2px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.8); font-size: 10.4px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); }
.rail-expand:hover { background: var(--nh-blue-hover); color: #fff; }
.rail-items { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 4.8px 0; gap: 1.6px; }
.rail-btn { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 3.2px; height: 44.8px; color: rgba(255,255,255,.9); font-size: var(--fs-xs); letter-spacing: -0.2px; transition: background .12s, color .12s; position: relative; }
.rail-btn .anticon { font-size: 15.2px; }
.rail-btn:hover { background: var(--nh-blue-hover); color: #fff; }
.rail-btn.on { background: var(--nh-blue-active); color: #fff; }
.rail-btn.on::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2.4px; border-radius: 0 2.4px 2.4px 0; background: var(--nh-gold); }
.rail-bottom { margin-top: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 1.6px; padding: 6.4px 0 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14); }
.rail-icon-btn { all: unset; cursor: pointer; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: rgba(255,255,255,.85); font-size: 14.4px; transition: background .12s; }
.rail-icon-btn:hover { background: var(--nh-blue-hover); color: #fff; }
.rail-avatar { width: 25.6px; height: 25.6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--nh-gold); color: #16305c; font-weight: 800; font-size: 10.4px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; margin-top: 3.2px; }
.rail-badge { position: absolute; top: 4.8px; right: 6.4px; min-width: 12.8px; height: 12.8px; padding: 0 3.2px; border-radius: 6.4px; background: var(--danger); color: #fff; font-size: 8px; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }

/* ===== 사이드 패널 (2026-11-13 현업 화면 기준: 흰 배경, 대메뉴 제목 + 중메뉴 폴더(진한 글자) + 소메뉴 14px, 선택 = 남색 채움) ===== */
.app-panel { width: var(--panel-w); background: #fff; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: none; transition: width .15s; }
.app-panel.flyout { position: absolute; left: var(--rail-w); top: 0; bottom: 0; box-shadow: 6.4px 0 19.2px rgba(5,70,129,.14); z-index: 30; }
.panel-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6.4px; padding: 11.2px 8px 8px 12.8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
.panel-head .anticon { color: var(--primary); font-size: 12.8px; }
.panel-head-actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.6px; }
.panel-body { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 6.4px 8px 9.6px; }
.panel-section { margin-bottom: 3.2px; padding-bottom: 3.2px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
.panel-section:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.panel-folder { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; width: 100%; padding: 8px 6.4px 6.4px; font-size: var(--fs); color: var(--text-secondary); font-weight: 600; }
.panel-folder:hover { color: var(--primary); }
.panel-folder .anticon { font-size: 9.6px; transition: transform .15s; }
.panel-folder.open .anticon { transform: rotate(180deg); }
.panel-leaf { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4.8px; width: 100%; padding: 6.4px 9.6px; border-radius: 4.8px; font-size: var(--fs); color: var(--text); line-height: 1.35; position: relative; }
.panel-leaf:hover { background: #eef4fb; }
.panel-leaf.on { background: var(--primary); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }
.panel-leaf .nm { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.panel-leaf .sid { font-size: 8.8px; color: var(--text-secondary); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.panel-leaf.on .sid { color: rgba(255,255,255,.7); }
.panel-leaf .adm { font-size: 8.8px; font-weight: 700; padding: 0 3.2px; border-radius: 2.4px; background: var(--info-bg); color: var(--info); }
.panel-leaf.on .adm { background: rgba(255,255,255,.2); color: #fff; }
.panel-leaf .star { opacity: 0; font-size: 10.4px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.panel-leaf:hover .star, .panel-leaf .star.fav { opacity: 1; }
.panel-leaf .star.fav { color: var(--nh-gold); }
.panel-leaf.on .star { color: #fff; }
.panel-divider { height: 1px; background: var(--border-light); margin: 6.4px 4.8px; }
.panel-empty { padding: 6.4px 8px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); line-height: 1.6; }
/* 사이드바 맨 위 "☆ 즐겨찾기 ▾" 상자(시안 p.10, 모든 화면) */
.panel-fav-box { padding: 8px 8px 1.6px; }
.panel-fav-head { all: unset; box-sizing: border-box; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4.8px; width: 100%; height: 25.6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4.8px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: var(--fs); font-weight: 600; color: var(--text); background: #fff; }
.panel-fav-head:hover { border-color: var(--primary); }
.panel-fav-head .anticon-down { margin-left: auto; font-size: 8.8px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.panel-foot { border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light); padding: 6.4px 6.4px 8px; }
.quick-link { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6.4px; width: 100%; padding: 4.8px 6.4px; border-radius: 4.8px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.quick-link:hover { background: #f3f7fc; color: var(--text); }
.quick-link .anticon { font-size: 11.2px; color: var(--text-secondary); }
.user-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 6.4px 4.8px; margin-top: 4.8px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light); }
.user-card .avatar { width: 27.2px; height: 27.2px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--nh-gold); color: #16305c; font-weight: 800; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex: none; }
.user-card .nm { font-weight: 700; font-size: var(--fs); }
.user-card .dept { font-size: var(--fs-xs); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.panel-settings { all: unset; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6.4px; padding: 4.8px 6.4px; font-size: var(--fs-sm); color: var(--text-secondary); border-radius: 4.8px; width: 100%; }
.panel-settings:hover { background: #f3f7fc; color: var(--text); }
.panel-foot-actions { display: flex; gap: 3.2px; }
.panel-foot-actions .panel-settings { width: auto; flex: 1; }
```

#### F9. 전체 교체 `Frontend/nh-atms-web/src/components/grid/useFillHeight.ts`

> 이 파일: 표 채우기 높이에 아래 줄의 위아래 여백도 넣고, 나중에 생긴 아래 줄도 지켜봄.

```ts
import { useEffect, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';

/** 남은 높이 채우기를 할 때 표 몸통의 최소 높이(약 5행) */
const MIN_BODY = 160;

/**
 * 표가 화면의 남은 높이를 채우게 하는 훅(2026-11-13 사용자 결정 — 콘텐츠 영역은 스크롤 없이, 표 높이가 조회조건 양에 따라 가변).
 *
 * 동작
 *  - 표를 감싼 div(ref)의 **부모가 세로 flex**(화면 틀 `.page-frame`, 탭 칸, 마스터·디테일 칸 등 — CSS 가 그렇게 만듦)이고 팝업 안이 아니면 '채우기' 를 켠다.
 *    켜지면 div 에 `grid-fill` 클래스(남은 높이를 차지)를 붙이고, div 높이에서 표 머리글·페이지 줄·도구줄을 뺀 값을 표 몸통 높이(scroll.y)로 돌려준다.
 *  - 창 크기·조회조건 줄 수·행 수가 바뀌면 다시 잰다(ResizeObserver). 스크롤은 표 안에서만 생긴다.
 *  - 부모가 세로 flex 가 아니면(팝업·공통 모듈 시연 카드 등) 아무것도 하지 않는다 → 예전처럼 내용 높이.
 *  - 높이를 숫자로 준 표(`height={…}`)는 이 훅을 쓰지 않는다(enabled = false).
 *
 * @returns fill 여부와 표 몸통 높이(px). fill 이 아니면 y = undefined
 */
export const useFillHeight = (ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, enabled: boolean): { fill: boolean; y: number | undefined } => {
  const [state, setState] = useState<{ fill: boolean; y: number | undefined }>({ fill: false, y: undefined });

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!enabled || !el || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const parent = el.parentElement;

    const measure = () => {
      if (!parent || el.closest('.ant-modal')) return setState((s) => (s.fill ? { fill: false, y: undefined } : s));
      const cs = getComputedStyle(parent);
      const column = cs.display.includes('flex') && cs.flexDirection === 'column';
      if (!column) return setState((s) => (s.fill ? { fill: false, y: undefined } : s));
      if (el.clientHeight === 0) return; // 숨은 탭(keep-alive) — 보일 때 다시 잰다
      // div 안에서 표 몸통이 아닌 부분(머리글·페이지 줄·도구줄)의 높이
      const body = el.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ant-table-body') ?? el.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.ant-table-tbody');
      // 자식(표·'총 n건' 줄·페이지 줄·도구줄)의 높이 + 위아래 여백. 새로 생긴 자식(조회 뒤 나타나는 아래 줄)도 지켜본다
      const kids = Array.from(el.children) as HTMLElement[];
      kids.forEach((k) => ro.observe(k));
      const content = kids.reduce((sum, k) => {
        const ks = getComputedStyle(k);
        return sum + k.offsetHeight + (parseFloat(ks.marginTop) || 0) + (parseFloat(ks.marginBottom) || 0);
      }, 0);
      const other = content - (body?.offsetHeight ?? 0);
      const y = Math.max(MIN_BODY, Math.floor(el.clientHeight - other));
      setState((s) => (s.fill && s.y !== undefined && Math.abs(s.y - y) <= 1 ? s : { fill: true, y }));
    };

    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => measure());
    measure();
    ro.observe(el);
    if (parent) ro.observe(parent);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [ref, enabled]);

  return enabled ? state : { fill: false, y: undefined };
};
```

#### F10. 전체 교체 `Frontend/nh-atms-web/src/components/grid/DataGrid.tsx`

> 이 파일: 페이징 없는 표 아래 '총 n건' 한 줄.

```tsx
import { useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Pagination, Select, Table, type TableProps } from 'antd';
import type { ColumnsType } from 'antd/es/table';
import type { TableRowSelection } from 'antd/es/table/interface';
import { EMPTY_RESULT_TEXT, PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS } from '@/config/constants';
import { fmtCount } from '@/utils/format';
import { sumWidth } from './columns';
import { useFillHeight } from './useFillHeight';

/** 조회 전 안내문 */
export const BEFORE_SEARCH_TEXT = '조회 조건을 입력하고 [조회]를 누르세요.';
const showTotal = (t: number) => `총 ${fmtCount(t)}건`;

export type GridGrade = 'G1' | 'G2' | 'G3';

export interface DataGridProps<T extends object> {
  columns: ColumnsType<T>;
  rows: T[];
  rowKey: keyof T | ((row: T) => string);
  loading?: boolean;
  /** 조회 전 상태면 안내 문구 변경 */
  searched?: boolean;
  /** 그리드 등급(08 §3.1). G1 폭 100% / G2 폭 100%+최소폭 / G3 항상 가로 스크롤 */
  grade?: GridGrade;
  /**
   * 세로 스크롤 높이(px). 없으면 화면의 남은 높이를 채운다(부모가 세로 flex 일 때 — 화면 틀·탭·마스터/디테일, useFillHeight).
   * 팝업 안 등 그 밖에서는 내용만큼. 숫자는 정말 고정해야 할 때만(2026-11-13 사용자 결정: 표 높이는 가변)
   */
  height?: number;
  /** 서버 페이징 */
  pagination?: { page: number; size: number; total: number; onChange: (page: number, size: number) => void } | false;
  /** 클라이언트 페이징 크기 (pagination 미지정 시). 0 이면 페이징 없음 */
  clientPageSize?: number;
  rowSelection?: TableRowSelection<T>;
  onRowClick?: (row: T) => void;
  onRowDoubleClick?: (row: T) => void;
  rowClassName?: (row: T, index: number) => string;
  /** 선택 강조할 행 키(단일 또는 복수). rowKey 결과와 비교 */
  selectedKey?: string | string[] | null;
  /** 선택 강조 판정을 직접(코너 단위 선택 등) */
  isSelected?: (row: T) => boolean;
  summary?: TableProps<T>['summary'];
  emptyText?: ReactNode;
  size?: 'small' | 'middle';
  /** 세로 줄. 시안(2026-10-21)은 가로 줄만이라 기본 false. 그룹 헤더·숫자 많은 표는 true */
  bordered?: boolean;
  /** 빈 상태에서도 테이블 헤더 표시 (기본 true) */
  showHeaderWhenEmpty?: boolean;
  footer?: ReactNode;
  /** 페이지 줄 왼쪽 칸(시안: '조회일자 : 2026-09-17'). 없으면 '총 N건' */
  footLeft?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  /**
   * 컬럼 헤더 클릭 정렬(현업 회신 2026-10-30 No 19 "라이브러리가 지원하면 적용, 새마을과 동일하게"). 기본 true.
   * dataIndex 가 있는 리프 컬럼에 값 기준 정렬을 붙인다(문자/숫자). 서버 페이징이면 **현재 페이지 안**에서만 정렬된다(새마을과 같음).
   * 컬럼에 `sorter` 가 이미 있으면 그대로, `sorter: false` 면 제외.
   */
  sortable?: boolean;
}

/** 리프 컬럼에 기본 정렬기 부여 */
const cmp = (a: unknown, b: unknown): number => {
  const na = a === null || a === undefined || a === '';
  const nb = b === null || b === undefined || b === '';
  if (na && nb) return 0;
  if (na) return 1;
  if (nb) return -1;
  if (typeof a === 'number' && typeof b === 'number') return a - b;
  return String(a).localeCompare(String(b), 'ko', { numeric: true });
};
const withSorters = <T,>(cols: ColumnsType<T>): ColumnsType<T> =>
  cols.map((c) => {
    if ('children' in c && Array.isArray(c.children)) return { ...c, children: withSorters(c.children as ColumnsType<T>) } as typeof c;
    const col = c as typeof c & { dataIndex?: unknown; sorter?: unknown };
    if (col.sorter !== undefined || typeof col.dataIndex !== 'string') return c;
    const key = col.dataIndex;
    return { ...c, sorter: (x: T, y: T) => cmp((x as Record<string, unknown>)[key], (y as Record<string, unknown>)[key]), showSorterTooltip: false } as typeof c;
  });

/**
 * 데이터 그리드 — antd Table 래퍼.
 *  - 컬럼 폭 합으로 scroll.x 자동 계산, 고정 컬럼/그룹헤더/합계행은 antd 내장 기능 사용(추가 라이브러리 없음)
 *  - 서버 페이징(pagination) 또는 클라이언트 페이징(clientPageSize). 페이지 줄은 시안대로 왼쪽 안내 / 가운데 페이지 / 오른쪽 'N개씩 보기'
 *  - 빈 결과: '검색된 데이터가 없습니다.'(AS-IS 문구), 조회 전: 안내문
 */
export function DataGrid<T extends object>({
  columns, rows, rowKey, loading, searched = true, grade = 'G2', height, pagination, clientPageSize = 20, rowSelection, onRowClick, onRowDoubleClick, rowClassName, selectedKey, isSelected, summary, emptyText, size = 'small', bordered = false, footer, footLeft, className, sortable = true,
}: DataGridProps<T>) {
  const sortedColumns = useMemo(() => (sortable ? withSorters(columns) : columns), [columns, sortable]);
  const totalWidth = useMemo(() => sumWidth(columns as never), [columns]);
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const fill = useFillHeight(boxRef, height === undefined);
  const bodyY = height ?? fill.y;
  const scroll = useMemo(() => {
    const x = grade === 'G1' ? undefined : grade === 'G2' ? Math.max(totalWidth, 0) : totalWidth;
    return { x: x && x > 0 ? x : undefined, y: bodyY };
  }, [grade, totalWidth, bodyY]);

  const empty = <div className="grid-empty">{emptyText ?? (searched ? EMPTY_RESULT_TEXT : BEFORE_SEARCH_TEXT)}</div>;
  const keyOf = (r: T): string => (typeof rowKey === 'function' ? rowKey(r) : String(r[rowKey]));
  const selected = (r: T): boolean => (isSelected ? isSelected(r) : selectedKey === undefined || selectedKey === null ? false : Array.isArray(selectedKey) ? selectedKey.includes(keyOf(r)) : keyOf(r) === selectedKey);
  const isServer = pagination !== undefined && pagination !== false;
  // 클라이언트 페이징: antd Table 의 페이저는 숨기고 상태만 공유한다(정렬은 전체 행 기준 유지)
  const [client, setClient] = useState({ page: 1, size: clientPageSize });
  const clientPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(rows.length / Math.max(1, client.size)));
  const clientPage = Math.min(client.page, clientPages);
  const paged = isServer
    ? { page: pagination.page, size: pagination.size, total: pagination.total, onChange: pagination.onChange }
    : clientPageSize === 0
      ? null
      : { page: clientPage, size: client.size, total: rows.length, onChange: (page: number, size: number) => setClient({ page, size }) };

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className={`data-grid${fill.fill ? ' grid-fill' : ''}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`}>
      <Table<T>
        columns={sortedColumns}
        dataSource={rows}
        rowKey={rowKey as never}
        loading={loading}
        size={size}
        bordered={bordered}
        sticky={bodyY === undefined ? { offsetHeader: 0 } : undefined}
        scroll={scroll}
        tableLayout={grade === 'G1' ? 'auto' : 'fixed'}
        rowSelection={rowSelection}
        summary={summary}
        locale={{ emptyText: empty }}
        pagination={isServer || clientPageSize === 0 ? false : { current: clientPage, pageSize: client.size, total: rows.length, style: { display: 'none' } }}
        onRow={(record) => ({
          onClick: onRowClick ? () => onRowClick(record) : undefined,
          onDoubleClick: onRowDoubleClick ? () => onRowDoubleClick(record) : undefined,
        })}
        rowClassName={(r, i) => [rowClassName?.(r, i), onRowClick || onRowDoubleClick ? 'row-clickable' : '', selected(r) ? 'ant-table-row-selected' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ')}
      />
      {/* 페이징 없는 표도 아래에 '총 n건' 한 줄 — 표 끝이 어디인지 보이게(2026-11-13 사용자 결정, 표 테두리는 global.css) */}
      {!paged && rows.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid-foot grid-foot-plain">
          <div className="gf-left">{footLeft ?? showTotal(rows.length)}</div>
        </div>
      )}
      {paged && paged.total > 0 && (
        <div className="grid-foot">
          <div className="gf-left">{footLeft ?? showTotal(paged.total)}</div>
          <Pagination current={paged.page} pageSize={paged.size} total={paged.total} onChange={paged.onChange} showSizeChanger={false} itemRender={itemRender} />
          <Select className="gf-size" size="small" value={paged.size} onChange={(s) => paged.onChange(1, s)} options={PAGE_SIZE_OPTIONS.map((n) => ({ value: Number(n), label: `${n}개씩 보기` }))} aria-label="페이지 크기" />
        </div>
      )}
      {footer}
    </div>
  );
}

const itemRender: NonNullable<TableProps<object>['pagination'] & object>['itemRender'] = (_page, type, original) => {
  if (type === 'prev') return <a style={{ padding: '0 6px' }}>‹ 이전</a>;
  if (type === 'next') return <a style={{ padding: '0 6px' }}>다음 ›</a>;
  return original;
};
```

#### F11. 전체 교체 `Frontend/nh-atms-web/src/components/grid/EditableGrid.tsx`

> 이 파일: 편집 표 아래 '총 n건' 한 줄 + 칸 안 폼 칸을 작은 크기로(행 높이 = 목록 표). 제목(title)을 주면 도구줄이 결과 머리 줄 — '제목 (n건) · 변경 내역 … [엑셀][저장][취소]' 한 줄.

```tsx
import { useEffect, useImperativeHandle, useMemo, useRef, useState, type Key, type ReactNode, type Ref } from 'react';
import { Button, Checkbox, DatePicker, Form, Input, InputNumber, Select, Table } from 'antd';
import type { CheckboxChangeEvent } from 'antd/es/checkbox';
import type { Rule } from 'antd/es/form';
import type { ColumnType } from 'antd/es/table';
import { YMD, dayjs, fromYmd, toYmd, type Dayjs } from '@/utils/date';
import { fmtAmount, fmtCount, fmtDate } from '@/utils/format';
import { AmountInput } from '@/components/forms/AmountInput';
import type { GridGrade } from './DataGrid';
import { sumWidth } from './columns';
import { useFillHeight } from './useFillHeight';
import './gridExt.css';

/** number = 일반 숫자(순서·점수, 소수 가능) · amount = 금액(정수, 입력 중에도 콤마 — AmountInput) */
export type EditType = 'input' | 'number' | 'amount' | 'select' | 'date' | 'check';

export interface EditableConfig<T = never> {
  type: EditType;
  /**
   * 행별 잠금 — true 를 돌려주면 그 행의 이 칸은 편집하지 않고 값만 보인다.
   * 예: 기존 행의 키 칸 잠금 `disabled: (_row, isNew) => !isNew` (새로 추가한 행만 입력)
   */
  disabled?: (row: T, isNew: boolean) => boolean;
  /** 잠긴 칸에 마우스를 올렸을 때 안내(title) */
  disabledTitle?: string;
  /** select 옵션 */
  options?: { label: ReactNode; value: string | number }[];
  rules?: Rule[];
  /** date 저장 포맷 (기본 YYYYMMDD — AS-IS 문자열 날짜) */
  valueFormat?: string;
  /** check 저장값 [체크, 해제] (기본 [true, false]) */
  checkValues?: [unknown, unknown];
  placeholder?: string;
}

/** 편집 컬럼 정의 — antd 컬럼 + editable */
export interface EditableColumn<T> extends ColumnType<T> {
  editable?: EditableConfig<T>;
}

export interface EditableChanges<T> {
  added: T[];
  updated: T[];
  deleted: T[];
}

export interface EditableGridHandle<T> {
  /** 추가/수정/삭제 행 */
  getChanges: () => EditableChanges<T>;
  /** 편집 셀 검증 (삭제 행 제외) */
  validate: () => Promise<boolean>;
  /** 편집 내용 전부 취소 */
  reset: () => void;
  /** 행 추가 — 임시 키 반환 */
  addRow: (init?: Partial<T>) => string;
  hasChanges: () => boolean;
}

export interface EditableGridProps<T extends object> {
  columns: EditableColumn<T>[];
  rows: T[];
  rowKey: keyof T | ((row: T) => string);
  ref?: Ref<EditableGridHandle<T>>;
  /** 저장 — 검증 통과 시 호출. 지정 시 [저장] 버튼 표시 */
  onSave?: (changes: EditableChanges<T>) => void | Promise<void>;
  readOnly?: boolean;
  /** 툴바 버튼·편집 권한(기본 모두 true, readOnly 가 우선). 화면은 usePermission 값을 넘긴다 — 예 canAdd={perm.canReg} */
  canAdd?: boolean;
  /** 기존 행 셀 편집(수정) 가능 — false 면 기존 행은 값만 보인다(추가 행은 canAdd 로 편집) */
  canUpdate?: boolean;
  /** [행삭제]·행 체크 가능 */
  canDelete?: boolean;
  /** [행추가]·[행삭제] 버튼을 보일지(기본 true). 행 수가 정해진 표(예: 권한관리 메뉴 권한 — 메뉴 전체 고정)는 false */
  rowButtons?: boolean;
  /** [저장] 가능 */
  canSave?: boolean;
  /** 새 행 기본값 */
  newRow?: () => Partial<T>;
  grade?: GridGrade;
  /** 세로 스크롤 높이(px). 없으면 화면의 남은 높이를 채운다(DataGrid 와 같음, useFillHeight) */
  height?: number;
  loading?: boolean;
  /** 내장 툴바 표시 (기본 true) */
  toolbar?: boolean;
  toolbarExtra?: ReactNode;
  /**
   * 표 제목 — 주면 도구줄이 결과 머리 줄이 된다: 왼쪽 '제목 (n건)' + 변경 내역, 오른쪽 toolbarExtra·저장·취소.
   * 화면에서 따로 ResultHeader 를 두지 않아 한 줄이 줄고 표가 그만큼 높아진다(2026-11-13 사용자 결정).
   */
  title?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

type Values = Record<string, Record<string, unknown>>;
interface Entry<T> {
  key: string;
  row: T;
  added: boolean;
  deleted: boolean;
}

const TEMP_PREFIX = '__new_';
let tempSeq = 0;

const fieldOf = <T,>(c: EditableColumn<T>): string => {
  const di = c.dataIndex;
  if (Array.isArray(di)) return di.join('.');
  return String(di ?? c.key ?? '');
};
const get = (row: unknown, f: string): unknown => (row as Record<string, unknown>)[f];
const norm = (v: unknown) => (v === null || v === undefined || v === '' ? '' : v);
const same = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => Object.is(norm(a), norm(b));

/** 셀 표시값 (편집 불가 상태) */
const display = <T,>(c: EditableColumn<T>, v: unknown, row: T, i: number): ReactNode => {
  if (c.render) return c.render(v, row, i) as ReactNode;
  const ed = c.editable;
  if (!ed) return v === null || v === undefined || v === '' ? '' : String(v);
  if (ed.type === 'check') return <Checkbox checked={v === (ed.checkValues?.[0] ?? true)} disabled />;
  if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') return '';
  if (ed.type === 'select') return ed.options?.find((o) => o.value === v)?.label ?? String(v);
  if (ed.type === 'date') return fmtDate(String(v));
  if (ed.type === 'number' || ed.type === 'amount') return fmtAmount(v as number);
  return String(v);
};

/** 편집 컨트롤 */
const editor = <T,>(ed: EditableConfig<T>, label: string): ReactNode => {
  switch (ed.type) {
    case 'number':
      return <InputNumber size="small" style={{ width: '100%' }} aria-label={label} placeholder={ed.placeholder} />;
    case 'amount':
      return <AmountInput size="small" aria-label={label} placeholder={ed.placeholder} />;
    case 'select':
      return <Select size="small" style={{ width: '100%' }} options={ed.options} aria-label={label} placeholder={ed.placeholder} allowClear />;
    case 'date':
      return <DatePicker size="small" style={{ width: '100%' }} aria-label={label} placeholder={ed.placeholder} />;
    case 'check':
      return <Checkbox aria-label={label} />;
    default:
      return <Input size="small" aria-label={label} placeholder={ed.placeholder} />;
  }
};

/** 컨트롤 ↔ 저장값 변환(Form.Item props) */
const itemProps = <T,>(ed: EditableConfig<T>) => {
  if (ed.type === 'date') {
    const fmt = ed.valueFormat ?? YMD;
    const parse = (v: unknown): Dayjs | null => (fmt === YMD ? fromYmd(String(v)) ?? null : dayjs(String(v), fmt));
    return {
      getValueProps: (v: unknown) => ({ value: v ? parse(v) : null }),
      normalize: (d: Dayjs | null) => (fmt === YMD ? toYmd(d) : d ? d.format(fmt) : undefined),
    };
  }
  if (ed.type === 'check') {
    const [on, off] = ed.checkValues ?? [true, false];
    return {
      getValueProps: (v: unknown) => ({ checked: v === on }),
      getValueFromEvent: (e: CheckboxChangeEvent) => (e.target.checked ? on : off),
    };
  }
  return {};
};

/**
 * 인라인 편집 그리드 (견본: 기기모델코드 일괄 저장).
 *  - 그리드당 Form 1개, 셀마다 Form.Item(name=[행키, 필드])
 *  - 변경 셀 'cell-dirty', 추가 행 'row-added', 삭제 행 'row-deleted'(취소선)
 *  - ref 로 getChanges/validate/reset 제공, [행추가/행삭제/저장/취소] 툴바 내장
 *  - 행별 잠금 `editable.disabled(row, isNew)`(예: 기존 행 키 칸), 버튼별 권한 `canAdd`·`canUpdate`·`canDelete`·`canSave`
 */
export function EditableGrid<T extends object>({
  columns, rows, rowKey, ref, onSave, readOnly = false, canAdd = true, canUpdate = true, canDelete = true, rowButtons = true, canSave = true, newRow, grade = 'G2', height, loading, toolbar = true, toolbarExtra, title, className,
}: EditableGridProps<T>) {
  const [form] = Form.useForm<Values>();
  const keyOf = (r: T): string => (typeof rowKey === 'function' ? rowKey(r) : String(r[rowKey]));

  const editCols = useMemo(() => columns.filter((c) => c.editable), [columns]);
  const toEntries = (src: T[]): Entry<T>[] => src.map((r) => ({ key: keyOf(r), row: r, added: false, deleted: false }));
  const rowValues = (r: T) => Object.fromEntries(editCols.map((c) => [fieldOf(c), get(r, fieldOf(c))]));
  const initialValues: Values = Object.fromEntries(rows.map((r) => [keyOf(r), rowValues(r)]));

  const [src, setSrc] = useState(rows);
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<Entry<T>[]>(() => toEntries(rows));
  const [dirty, setDirty] = useState<Record<string, string[]>>({});
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Key[]>([]);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

  // rows 교체 시 편집 상태 초기화 (렌더 중 동기화)
  if (src !== rows) {
    setSrc(rows);
    setEntries(toEntries(rows));
    setDirty({});
    setSelected([]);
  }
  useEffect(() => {
    form.resetFields();
  }, [rows, form]);

  /** 행의 변경 필드 목록 */
  const dirtyOf = (e: Entry<T>, vals: Values): string[] =>
    e.added ? [] : editCols.map(fieldOf).filter((f) => vals[e.key] && f in vals[e.key] && !same(vals[e.key][f], get(e.row, f)));

  const computeChanges = (): EditableChanges<T> => {
    const vals = form.getFieldsValue(true) as Values;
    const merged = (e: Entry<T>) => ({ ...e.row, ...(vals[e.key] ?? {}) }) as T;
    return {
      added: entries.filter((e) => e.added && !e.deleted).map(merged),
      updated: entries.filter((e) => !e.added && !e.deleted && dirtyOf(e, vals).length > 0).map(merged),
      deleted: entries.filter((e) => !e.added && e.deleted).map((e) => e.row),
    };
  };

  const changeCount = {
    updated: entries.filter((e) => !e.added && !e.deleted && (dirty[e.key]?.length ?? 0) > 0).length,
    added: entries.filter((e) => e.added).length,
    deleted: entries.filter((e) => e.deleted).length,
  };
  const changed = changeCount.updated + changeCount.added + changeCount.deleted > 0;

  const addRow = (init?: Partial<T>): string => {
    tempSeq += 1;
    const key = `${TEMP_PREFIX}${tempSeq}`;
    const row = { ...(newRow?.() ?? {}), ...(init ?? {}) } as T;
    form.setFieldValue(key, rowValues(row));
    setEntries((prev) => [...prev, { key, row, added: true, deleted: false }]);
    return key;
  };

  const reset = () => {
    form.resetFields();
    setEntries(toEntries(rows));
    setDirty({});
    setSelected([]);
  };

  const validate = async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    try {
      await form.validateFields();
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  };

  /** 선택 행 삭제 표시 (모두 삭제 상태면 복원). 추가 행은 즉시 제거 */
  const toggleDelete = () => {
    const sel = new Set(selected.map(String));
    const targets = entries.filter((e) => sel.has(e.key));
    const restore = targets.length > 0 && targets.every((e) => e.deleted);
    setEntries((prev) => prev.filter((e) => !(e.added && sel.has(e.key) && !restore)).map((e) => (sel.has(e.key) ? { ...e, deleted: !restore } : e)));
    setSelected([]);
  };

  const save = async () => {
    if (!onSave || !(await validate())) return;
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await onSave(computeChanges());
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  };

  /** 이 행의 이 칸을 편집하나 — 추가 행은 canAdd, 기존 행은 canUpdate, 그다음 칸의 disabled(row, isNew) */
  const cellEditable = (ed: EditableConfig<T>, e: Entry<T>): boolean => {
    if (e.added ? !canAdd : !canUpdate) return false;
    return !ed.disabled?.(e.row, e.added);
  };

  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({ getChanges: computeChanges, validate, reset, addRow, hasChanges: () => changed }));

  const tableCols = columns.map((c, ci): ColumnType<Entry<T>> => {
    const { editable, render: _render, onCell, ...rest } = c;
    const field = fieldOf(c);
    const label = typeof c.title === 'string' ? c.title : field;
    return {
      ...(rest as ColumnType<Entry<T>>),
      key: c.key ?? (field || ci),
      dataIndex: undefined,
      onCell: (e, i) => {
        const base = onCell?.(e.row, i) ?? {};
        const isDirty = !e.deleted && dirty[e.key]?.includes(field);
        const locked = !!editable && !readOnly && !e.deleted && !cellEditable(editable, e);
        return {
          ...base,
          title: locked && editable?.disabledTitle ? editable.disabledTitle : base.title,
          className: [base.className, isDirty ? 'cell-dirty' : '', locked ? 'cell-locked' : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' ') || undefined,
        };
      },
      render: (_: unknown, e: Entry<T>, i: number) => {
        if (editable && !readOnly && !e.deleted && cellEditable(editable, e)) {
          return (
            <Form.Item name={[e.key, field]} rules={editable.rules} valuePropName={editable.type === 'check' ? 'checked' : 'value'} style={{ margin: 0 }} {...itemProps(editable)}>
              {editor(editable, label)}
            </Form.Item>
          );
        }
        const v = editable ? (form.getFieldValue([e.key, field]) ?? get(e.row, field)) : get(e.row, field);
        return display(c, v, e.row, i);
      },
    };
  });

  const selectable = !readOnly && canDelete;
  const totalWidth = sumWidth(columns as never) + (selectable ? 40 : 0);
  const boxRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const fill = useFillHeight(boxRef, height === undefined);
  const scroll = { x: grade === 'G1' ? undefined : totalWidth, y: height ?? fill.y };

  return (
    <div ref={boxRef} className={`data-grid editable-grid${fill.fill ? ' grid-fill' : ''}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`}>
      {toolbar && (
        <div className={`grid-ext-toolbar${title ? ' as-header' : ''}`}>
          <span className="ge-summary">
            {title && (
              <span className="ge-title">
                <b>{title}</b> <span className="n">({fmtCount(rows.length)}건)</span>
              </span>
            )}
            {changed ? (
              <>
                변경 <b>{changeCount.updated}</b> · 추가 <b>{changeCount.added}</b> · 삭제 <b>{changeCount.deleted}</b>
              </>
            ) : (
              <span className="muted">변경 내역 없음</span>
            )}
          </span>
          <span className="flex">
            {toolbarExtra}
            {rowButtons && (
              <>
                <Button size="small" onClick={() => addRow()} disabled={readOnly || !canAdd}>
                  행추가
                </Button>
                <Button size="small" onClick={toggleDelete} disabled={readOnly || !canDelete || selected.length === 0}>
                  행삭제
                </Button>
              </>
            )}
            {onSave && (
              <Button size="small" type="primary" onClick={() => void save()} loading={saving} disabled={readOnly || !canSave || !changed}>
                저장
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button size="small" onClick={reset} disabled={readOnly || !changed}>
              취소
            </Button>
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
      {/* size small: 칸 안 입력·콤보·체크를 작은 높이(20.8px)로 → 행 높이가 목록 표(DataGrid)와 같아짐(2026-11-13 사용자 결정) */}
      <Form<Values>
        form={form}
        size="small"
        component={false}
        initialValues={initialValues}
        onValuesChange={(chg: Partial<Values>, all: Values) => {
          setDirty((prev) => {
            const next = { ...prev };
            for (const k of Object.keys(chg)) {
              const e = entries.find((x) => x.key === k);
              if (e) next[k] = dirtyOf(e, all);
            }
            return next;
          });
        }}
      >
        <Table<Entry<T>>
          columns={tableCols}
          dataSource={entries}
          rowKey="key"
          size="small"
          bordered
          loading={loading}
          pagination={false}
          scroll={scroll}
          tableLayout={grade === 'G1' ? 'auto' : 'fixed'}
          rowSelection={selectable ? { selectedRowKeys: selected, onChange: setSelected, columnWidth: 40 } : undefined}
          rowClassName={(e) => (e.deleted ? 'row-deleted' : e.added ? 'row-added' : '')}
        />
      </Form>
      {entries.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid-foot grid-foot-plain">
          <div className="gf-left">총 {fmtCount(entries.length)}건</div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

#### F12. 전체 교체 `Frontend/nh-atms-web/src/components/search/SearchForm.tsx`

> 이 파일: 날짜 칸 최소 폭 104 → 83.

```tsx
import React, { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { CSSProperties, KeyboardEvent, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Button, Checkbox, Col, DatePicker, Form, Input, Radio, Row, Select } from 'antd';
import type { FormInstance } from 'antd';
import type { Rule } from 'antd/es/form';
import { DownOutlined, ReloadOutlined, SearchOutlined, UpOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
// 시안(2026-10-21 p.5): 라디오는 일반 원형, 버튼은 '조회' 하나(보조 버튼은 그 위에 세로), '필터 펼침/접기' 링크는 조회 버튼 왼쪽
import { useContentBand, type Band } from '@/hooks/useContentBand';
import type { Option } from '@/types/common';
import { VMSG } from '@/config/messages';

/* ===================== 타입 ===================== */

/** 필드 폭 클래스: code(~160px) / normal(~220) / long(~300) / range(~340) / wide(행 절반) */
export type WidthClass = 'code' | 'normal' | 'long' | 'range' | 'wide';
export type SearchFieldType = 'input' | 'select' | 'datePicker' | 'rangePicker' | 'radio' | 'checkbox' | 'custom';

export type SearchOption = Option<string | number | boolean>;

export interface SearchField {
  name: string;
  label: string;
  type: SearchFieldType;
  widthClass?: WidthClass;
  /** 밴드별 span 강제 지정 (1..24) */
  span?: Partial<Record<Band, number>>;
  placeholder?: string;
  options?: SearchOption[];
  allowClear?: boolean;
  defaultValue?: unknown;
  required?: boolean;
  rules?: Rule[];
  disabled?: boolean;
  tooltip?: string;
  /** 항상 "상세 필터" 그룹 */
  advanced?: boolean;
  /** 이 필드부터 새 행 */
  newRow?: boolean;
  /** type === 'custom': value/onChange 를 받는 단일 컨트롤을 반환 */
  render?: (form: FormInstance) => ReactNode;
  componentProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
  /** Form.Item 의 valuePropName (checkbox 단일 등) */
  valuePropName?: string;
  /** 라벨 없이 컨트롤만 (체크박스처럼 컨트롤에 글자가 있는 경우 label='' 과 동일) */
  noLabel?: boolean;
}

export interface SearchFormProps {
  fields: SearchField[];
  onSearch: (values: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
  onReset?: () => void;
  form?: FormInstance;
  loading?: boolean;
  /** 보조 버튼(조회 버튼 위에 세로로 쌓임 — 시안) */
  extraButtons?: ReactNode;
  /** 항상 보이는 행 수 (기본 2). 초과분은 상세 필터로 */
  maxRows?: number;
  band?: Band;
  searchText?: string;
  /** 초기화 버튼. 시안에 없어 기본 숨김(2026-11-03 결정) */
  showReset?: boolean;
  colon?: boolean;
  labelStyle?: CSSProperties;
  /** 조건 패널 안 안내문(우측 상단) */
  note?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
  /** 처음부터 상세 필터 펼침 */
  defaultExpanded?: boolean;
}

/* ===================== 밴드 / span ===================== */

/** 밴드별 Col span (24 등분). 08_프론트_반응형_제안 §3.2 표 */
export const SPAN_TABLE: Record<Band, Record<WidthClass, number>> = {
  S: { code: 6, normal: 8, long: 12, range: 12, wide: 12 },
  M: { code: 5, normal: 6, long: 8, range: 8, wide: 12 },
  L: { code: 4, normal: 4, long: 6, range: 6, wide: 12 },
};

const DEFAULT_CLASS_BY_TYPE: Record<SearchFieldType, WidthClass> = { input: 'normal', select: 'normal', custom: 'normal', datePicker: 'code', rangePicker: 'range', radio: 'long', checkbox: 'long' };

const resolveSpan = (field: SearchField, band: Band): number => {
  const override = field.span?.[band];
  const span = override ?? SPAN_TABLE[band][field.widthClass ?? DEFAULT_CLASS_BY_TYPE[field.type]];
  return Math.min(24, Math.max(1, Math.round(span)));
};

interface PackedField {
  field: SearchField;
  span: number;
  index: number;
}

/** 24 칸 기준 greedy 패킹: 남은 칸보다 큰 필드(또는 newRow)는 다음 행으로 */
export const packRows = (items: PackedField[]): PackedField[][] => {
  const rows: PackedField[][] = [];
  let current: PackedField[] = [];
  let used = 0;
  for (const item of items) {
    if (current.length > 0 && (used + item.span > 24 || item.field.newRow)) {
      rows.push(current);
      current = [];
      used = 0;
    }
    current.push(item);
    used += item.span;
  }
  if (current.length > 0) rows.push(current);
  return rows;
};

/* ===================== 컨트롤 ===================== */

const renderControl = (field: SearchField, form: FormInstance): ReactNode => {
  const extra = field.componentProps ?? {};
  const common = { disabled: field.disabled };
  switch (field.type) {
    case 'input':
      return <Input placeholder={field.placeholder} allowClear {...common} {...extra} />;
    case 'select':
      return <Select placeholder={field.placeholder ?? '전체'} allowClear={field.allowClear !== false} options={field.options} style={{ width: '100%' }} {...common} {...extra} />;
    case 'datePicker':
      return <DatePicker placeholder={field.placeholder} style={{ width: '100%', minWidth: 83 }} {...common} {...extra} />;
    case 'rangePicker':
      return <DatePicker.RangePicker style={{ width: '100%' }} {...common} {...extra} />;
    case 'radio':
      return <Radio.Group options={field.options as never} {...common} {...extra} />;
    case 'checkbox': {
      // 단일 체크박스(checkField): options 없이 valuePropName='checked' 면 Checkbox 하나, 아니면 Checkbox.Group
      if (!field.options && field.valuePropName === 'checked') {
        const { children, ...rest } = extra as { children?: ReactNode };
        return <Checkbox {...common} {...rest}>{children}</Checkbox>;
      }
      return <Checkbox.Group options={field.options as never} {...common} {...extra} />;
    }
    case 'custom': {
      if (field.render) return field.render(form);
      const rest = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(extra).filter(([k]) => k !== 'noStyle'));
      return <Input {...common} {...rest} />;
    }
    default:
      return <Input {...common} {...extra} />;
  }
};

/* ===================== 컴포넌트 ===================== */

/**
 * 조회조건 폼 (시안 2026-10-21): 흰 패널 + 라벨 칸, 2행 고정 + '필터 펼침 ∨' 링크(조회 버튼 왼쪽), 조회 버튼 우측 고정, 밴드별 span,
 * Enter→조회(IME/Select/DatePicker 예외), 접힌 상세 필드 값·검증 보존, 검증 실패 시 자동 펼침.
 */
export const SearchForm: React.FC<SearchFormProps> = ({
  fields, onSearch, onReset, form: externalForm, loading = false, extraButtons, maxRows = 2, band: forcedBand, searchText = '조회', showReset = false, colon = false, labelStyle, note, className, style, defaultExpanded = false,
}) => {
  const [form] = Form.useForm(externalForm);
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const { band, width } = useContentBand(rootRef, forcedBand);
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(defaultExpanded);

  const packed: PackedField[] = fields.map((field, index) => ({ field, span: resolveSpan(field, band), index }));
  const basicRows = packRows(packed.filter((p) => !p.field.advanced));
  const visibleRows = basicRows.slice(0, Math.max(0, maxRows));
  const overflow = basicRows.slice(Math.max(0, maxRows)).flat();
  const advancedItems = [...overflow, ...packed.filter((p) => p.field.advanced)].sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
  const hasAdvanced = advancedItems.length > 0;

  const initialValues: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const f of fields) if (f.defaultValue !== undefined) initialValues[f.name] = f.defaultValue;

  const handleFinish = (values: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    if (loading) return;
    onSearch(values);
  };
  const handleFinishFailed = ({ errorFields }: { errorFields: { name: (string | number)[] }[] }) => {
    if (expanded || !hasAdvanced) return;
    const names = new Set(advancedItems.map((p) => p.field.name));
    if (errorFields.some((e) => names.has(String(e.name[0])))) setExpanded(true);
  };
  const handleReset = () => {
    form.resetFields();
    onReset?.();
  };
  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
    if (e.nativeEvent.isComposing || e.nativeEvent.keyCode === 229) return;
    const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
    if (!target || target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return;
    if (target.closest('button, a, [role="button"]')) return;
    if (target.closest('.ant-select-open, .ant-picker, .ant-picker-dropdown')) {
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!loading) form.submit();
  };

  const renderItem = ({ field, span }: PackedField, hidden: boolean) => {
    // 필수 칸의 기본 문구('…을 입력하세요.')는 칸이 자기 필수 규칙(reqSelect 등 '…을 선택하세요.')을 갖고 있으면 넣지 않는다(문구 두 줄 방지)
    const ownRequired = (field.rules ?? []).some((r) => typeof r === 'object' && r !== null && 'required' in r && r.required === true);
    const rules: Rule[] = [...(field.required && !ownRequired ? [{ required: true, message: VMSG.required(field.label) } satisfies Rule] : []), ...(field.rules ?? [])];
    const noStyle = field.type === 'custom' && field.componentProps?.noStyle === true;
    const showLabel = !field.noLabel && field.label !== '';
    return (
      <Col key={field.name} span={span} style={hidden ? { display: 'none' } : undefined}>
        <Form.Item
          name={field.name}
          label={showLabel ? <span style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap', ...labelStyle }}>{field.label}</span> : undefined}
          messageVariables={{ label: field.label }}
          rules={rules.length > 0 ? rules : undefined}
          required={field.required}
          tooltip={field.tooltip}
          hidden={hidden}
          noStyle={noStyle || undefined}
          valuePropName={field.valuePropName}
        >
          {renderControl(field, form)}
        </Form.Item>
      </Col>
    );
  };

  const visibleNodes: ReactNode[] = [];
  visibleRows.forEach((row, i) => {
    const used = row.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.span, 0);
    const needBreak = i < visibleRows.length - 1 || hasAdvanced;
    row.forEach((p) => visibleNodes.push(renderItem(p, false)));
    if (needBreak && used < 24) visibleNodes.push(<Col key={`__fill-${i}`} span={24 - used} aria-hidden />);
  });

  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={className ? `search-panel ${className}` : 'search-panel'} style={style} data-band={band} data-width={width ?? undefined}>
      <Form form={form} layout="horizontal" size="middle" labelCol={{ flex: 'none' }} wrapperCol={{ flex: '1 1 0' }} labelWrap={false} colon={colon} initialValues={initialValues} onFinish={handleFinish} onFinishFailed={handleFinishFailed} onKeyDown={handleKeyDown} style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-start', gap: 12 }}>
        <div style={{ flex: '1 1 auto', minWidth: 0 }}>
          {note && <div className="page-note info" style={{ margin: '0 0 6px' }}>{note}</div>}
          <Row gutter={[12, 8]}>
            {visibleNodes}
            {advancedItems.map((p) => renderItem(p, !expanded))}
          </Row>
        </div>
        <div className="search-actions">
          {extraButtons}
          <div className="search-actions-row">
            {hasAdvanced && (
              <button type="button" className="search-toggle" onClick={() => setExpanded((v) => !v)} aria-expanded={expanded}>
                {expanded ? <>필터 접기 <UpOutlined /></> : <>필터 펼침 <DownOutlined /></>}
              </button>
            )}
            {showReset && <Button icon={<ReloadOutlined />} onClick={handleReset}>초기화</Button>}
            <Button type="primary" htmlType="submit" icon={<SearchOutlined />} loading={loading} className="search-btn">
              {searchText}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Form>
    </div>
  );
};
```

#### F13. 전체 교체 `Frontend/nh-atms-web/src/components/search/fields.tsx`

> 이 파일: 사무소 코드 칸 폭 66 → 62(6자리가 다 보이게).

```tsx
/**
 * 공통 조회조건 컨트롤 — 전 화면에서 반복되는 조건(사무소/기번/시간/기간/공통코드)을
 * value/onChange 컨트롤 + SearchField 팩토리로 제공한다. [원본] nh-atms `components/search/fields.tsx`.
 * 필드 이름은 TO-BE 컬럼 camelCase(설계 Q5): 사무소 `ofcCode`, 기번 `mcnNo`.
 * 콤보 원천은 공통 조회 API(`/api/lookup/*`, api/endpoints/lookup.ts).
 */
import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, DatePicker, Form, Input, Select, Space } from 'antd';
import type { FormInstance } from 'antd';
import { SearchOutlined } from '@ant-design/icons';
import type { Dayjs } from 'dayjs';
import { useCodes } from '@/hooks/useCodes';
import { useMcns, useOffices } from '@/hooks/useLookup';
import { useAuthStore, selectOfcCode } from '@/stores/useAuthStore';
import { timeOptions, today } from '@/utils/date';
import { fmtOffice } from '@/utils/format';
import type { SearchField } from './SearchForm';
import { OfficeSearchModal } from './OfficeSearchModal';
import type { Office } from '@/domain/lookup';
import type { PeriodUnit, ValueProps } from '@/types/common';
import { VMSG } from '@/config/messages';

export type { ValueProps };

/** 사무소코드 6자리 정규화(앞자리 0 채움) — 서버 OfficeCode.norm 과 같은 규칙 */
export const normOfcCode = (v: string): string => (v ? v.replace(/\D/g, '').padStart(6, '0') : '');

/* ---------- 사무소 선택: 셀렉트([코드] 명) + 코드 직접입력 + 돋보기 팝업 ---------- */
export const OfficeSelector = ({ value, onChange, disabled, allowEmpty }: ValueProps<string | undefined> & { allowEmpty?: boolean }) => {
  const { data: offices = [] } = useOffices();
  const [code, setCode] = useState(value ?? '');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [prevValue, setPrevValue] = useState(value);
  if (value !== prevValue) {
    setPrevValue(value);
    setCode(value ?? '');
  }
  const apply = () => {
    const hit = offices.find((o) => o.ofcCode === normOfcCode(code));
    if (hit) onChange?.(hit.ofcCode);
  };
  const select = (o: Office) => {
    onChange?.(o.ofcCode);
    setCode(o.ofcCode);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <Space.Compact style={{ width: '100%' }}>
        <Select
          value={value || undefined}
          disabled={disabled}
          onChange={(v) => { onChange?.(v); setCode(v ?? ''); }}
          options={offices.map((o) => ({ value: o.ofcCode, label: fmtOffice(o.ofcCode, o.kanm) }))}
          showSearch
          optionFilterProp="label"
          allowClear={allowEmpty}
          placeholder={allowEmpty ? '-- 사무소검색 --' : '사무소 선택'}
          style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}
        />
        <Input
          value={code}
          maxLength={6}
          placeholder="코드"
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-label="사무소코드"
          style={{ width: 62, textAlign: 'center' }}
          onChange={(e) => setCode(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))}
          onBlur={apply}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') {
              e.preventDefault();
              e.stopPropagation();
              apply();
            }
          }}
        />
        <Button icon={<SearchOutlined />} onClick={() => setOpen(true)} disabled={disabled} aria-label="사무소 검색" />
      </Space.Compact>
      <OfficeSearchModal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} onSelect={select} />
    </>
  );
};

/* ---------- 기번(기기): 사무소에 종속되는 셀렉트 ---------- */
/**
 * 기번 콤보 — 같은 폼의 사무소 칸(`officeField`, 기본 'ofcCode')을 보고 `GET /api/lookup/machines?ofcCode=` 로 채운다.
 * 사무소가 없으면 비활성. 목록에 없는 값은 비워 보인다. 라벨 '기번  코너명'.
 */
export const McnSelect = ({ value, onChange, disabled, form, officeField = 'ofcCode', allowAll = true, placeholder }: ValueProps<string | undefined> & { form: FormInstance; officeField?: string; allowAll?: boolean; placeholder?: string }) => {
  const ofcCode = Form.useWatch(officeField, form) as string | undefined;
  const { data: rows = [], isFetching } = useMcns(ofcCode);
  const options = useMemo(() => rows.map((m) => ({ value: m.mcnNo, label: m.instPstNm ? `${m.mcnNo}  ${m.instPstNm}` : m.mcnNo })), [rows]);
  const shown = options.some((o) => o.value === value) ? value : undefined;
  return <Select value={shown} onChange={onChange} options={options} loading={isFetching} allowClear={allowAll} placeholder={placeholder ?? (allowAll ? '전체' : '기번 선택')} disabled={disabled || !ofcCode} showSearch optionFilterProp="label" style={{ width: '100%' }} />;
};

/* ---------- 시간 범위 (HH:mm select) ---------- */
export interface TimeRangeValue {
  from: string;
  to: string;
}
export const TimeRangeSelect = ({ value, onChange, disabled, step = 30 }: ValueProps<TimeRangeValue | undefined> & { step?: number }) => {
  const opts = useMemo(() => timeOptions(step), [step]);
  const v = value ?? { from: '0000', to: '2359' };
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, width: '100%' }}>
      <Select value={v.from} onChange={(t) => onChange?.({ ...v, from: t })} options={opts} disabled={disabled} style={{ flex: 1 }} showSearch />
      <span className="muted">~</span>
      <Select value={v.to} onChange={(t) => onChange?.({ ...v, to: t })} options={opts} disabled={disabled} style={{ flex: 1 }} showSearch />
    </div>
  );
};

/* ---------- 기간 단위(일별/월별) + 범위 ---------- */
export interface PeriodValue {
  unit: PeriodUnit;
  range?: [Dayjs, Dayjs];
}
export const PeriodPicker = ({ value, onChange, disabled }: ValueProps<PeriodValue | undefined>) => {
  const v: PeriodValue = value ?? { unit: 'DAY' };
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, width: '100%' }}>
      <Select value={v.unit} onChange={(unit) => onChange?.({ ...v, unit })} options={[{ value: 'DAY', label: '일별' }, { value: 'MONTH', label: '월별' }]} disabled={disabled} style={{ width: 80 }} />
      <DatePicker.RangePicker value={v.range} onChange={(r) => onChange?.({ ...v, range: r && r[0] && r[1] ? [r[0], r[1]] : undefined })} picker={v.unit === 'MONTH' ? 'month' : 'date'} disabled={disabled} style={{ flex: 1 }} allowClear={false} />
    </div>
  );
};

/* ---------- 공통코드 셀렉트 (TB_CO_CODE 코드구분) ---------- */
export const CodeSelect = ({ value, onChange, disabled, codeType, allLabel = '전체', allowAll = true, placeholder }: ValueProps<string | undefined> & { codeType: string; allLabel?: string; allowAll?: boolean; placeholder?: string }) => {
  const { options, isFetching } = useCodes(codeType);
  const opts = allowAll ? [{ value: 'ALL', label: allLabel }, ...options] : options;
  return <Select value={value} onChange={onChange} options={opts} loading={isFetching} disabled={disabled} placeholder={placeholder} showSearch optionFilterProp="label" style={{ width: '100%' }} />;
};

/* ---------- SearchField 팩토리 ---------- */
/** 사무소 (이름 'ofcCode', 기본 필수). 기본값은 화면에서 `defaultValue: 내 사무소` 로 — useOfficeMcnFields 참고 */
export const officeField = (opts: Partial<SearchField> & { defaultValue?: string } = {}): SearchField => ({
  name: 'ofcCode',
  label: '사무소',
  type: 'custom',
  widthClass: 'long',
  required: true,
  render: () => <OfficeSelector allowEmpty={!opts.required && opts.required !== undefined} />,
  ...opts,
});

/** 기번 (이름 'mcnNo', 사무소 칸 종속 — officeField 이름을 바꿨으면 opts.officeField 로) */
export const mcnField = ({ officeField: ofcName = 'ofcCode', ...opts }: Partial<SearchField> & { officeField?: string } = {}): SearchField => ({
  name: 'mcnNo',
  label: '기번',
  type: 'custom',
  widthClass: 'normal',
  render: (form) => <McnSelect form={form} officeField={ofcName} />,
  ...opts,
});

export const timeRangeField = (opts: Partial<SearchField> = {}): SearchField => ({
  name: 'time',
  label: '시간',
  type: 'custom',
  widthClass: 'long',
  defaultValue: { from: '0000', to: '2359' },
  render: () => <TimeRangeSelect />,
  ...opts,
});

export const periodField = (opts: Partial<SearchField> = {}): SearchField => ({
  name: 'period',
  label: '기간',
  type: 'custom',
  widthClass: 'range',
  required: true,
  rules: [{ validator: (_r, v?: PeriodValue) => (v?.range ? Promise.resolve() : Promise.reject(new Error(VMSG.required('기간')))) }],
  render: () => <PeriodPicker />,
  ...opts,
});

/** 공통코드 콤보 (기본값 'ALL' = 전체) */
export const codeField = (name: string, label: string, codeType: string, opts: Partial<SearchField> = {}): SearchField => ({
  name,
  label,
  type: 'custom',
  widthClass: 'normal',
  defaultValue: 'ALL',
  render: () => <CodeSelect codeType={codeType} />,
  ...opts,
});

/** 단일 체크박스 조건 (라벨 없이 컨트롤 안에 글자) — `v[name] === true` */
export const checkField = (name: string, text: string, opts: Partial<SearchField> = {}): SearchField => ({
  name,
  label: '',
  type: 'checkbox',
  widthClass: 'normal',
  valuePropName: 'checked',
  defaultValue: false,
  componentProps: { children: text },
  ...opts,
});

/** 단일 날짜 조건 (기본 오늘, 필수) */
export const dateField = (name = 'date', label = '조회일자', opts: Partial<SearchField> = {}): SearchField => ({
  name,
  label,
  type: 'datePicker',
  required: true,
  defaultValue: today(),
  ...opts,
});

/**
 * 가장 흔한 조건 묶음: 사무소(내 사무소 기본) + 기번 [+ 조회일자].
 * 훅이므로 컴포넌트 본문에서 호출한다. 예: `const fields = useOfficeMcnFields({ date: true })`
 */
export const useOfficeMcnFields = (opts: { date?: boolean | string; officeLabel?: string; mcn?: boolean; extra?: SearchField[] } = {}): SearchField[] => {
  const ofcCode = useAuthStore(selectOfcCode);
  const { date, officeLabel, mcn = true, extra } = opts;
  return useMemo(() => {
    const out: SearchField[] = [officeField({ defaultValue: ofcCode || undefined, ...(officeLabel ? { label: officeLabel } : {}) })];
    if (mcn) out.push(mcnField());
    if (date) out.push(dateField('date', typeof date === 'string' ? date : '조회일자'));
    return extra ? [...out, ...extra] : out;
  }, [ofcCode, date, officeLabel, mcn, extra]);
};
```
